import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, sys, time

# 1. Search PubChem for the SMILES
smiles='Nc3nc(OCc1ccccc1)c2nc[nH]c2n3'
print('=== PubChem search for SMILES ===', flush=True)
try:
    url='https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/smiles/'+urllib.parse.quote(smiles)+'/property/Title,IUPACName,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,CID/JSON'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    resp=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    print('PubChem response:', resp[:2000], flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print('PubChem ERR', repr(e), flush=True)

# 2. RCSB chemical search - try POST
print('\n=== RCSB chemical search ===', flush=True)
q={"query":{"type":"terminal","service":"chemical","parameters":{"value":smiles,"type":"descriptor","match_type":"exact"}},"return_type":"entry","request_options":{"results_content_type":["experimental"],"paginate":{"start":0,"rows":25}}}
for method in ['POST','GET']:
    try:
        if method=='POST':
            req=urllib.request.Request('https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query', data=json.dumps(q).encode(), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Content-Type':'application/json'})
        else:
            req=urllib.request.Request('https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query?json='+urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(q)), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        resp=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
        print(f'{method} response:', resp[:3000], flush=True)
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{method} ERR', repr(e), flush=True)

# 3. Query each PDB entry for ligands/nonpolymer entities
print('\n=== PDB entry ligands ===', flush=True)
ids=[x.strip().upper() for x in open('/app/pdb_ids.txt') if x.strip()]
for pid in ids:
    try:
        url=f'https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/{pid}'
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        j=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
        # Look for nonpolymer entity info
        info=j.get('rcsb_entry_info',{})
        nonpoly_count=info.get('nonpolymer_entity_count',0)
        # Try to get polymer entities and nonpolymer entities
        entities=[]
        for k,v in j.items():
            if 'nonpolymer' in k.lower() or 'ligand' in k.lower():
                entities.append((k, str(v)[:200]))
        # Also get struct title
        title=j.get('struct',{}).get('title','')
        print(f'{pid}: nonpoly_count={nonpoly_count}, title={title[:80]}', flush=True)
        if entities:
            print(f'  entity fields: {entities[:3]}', flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{pid}: ERR {repr(e)}', flush=True)

# 4. Try to get nonpolymer entities for each PDB entry
print('\n=== PDB nonpolymer entity details ===', flush=True)
for pid in ids:
    ligands=[]
    for eid in range(1, 6):
        try:
            url=f'https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/nonpolymer_entity/{pid}/{eid}'
            req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
            j=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
            comp=j.get('nonpolymer_comp',{})
            comp_id=comp.get('id','')
            name=comp.get('name','') or j.get('rcsb_nonpolymer_entity_container_identifiers',{}).get('comp_id','')
            formula=j.get('chem_comp',{}).get('formula','')
            desc=j.get('chem_comp',{}).get('name','') or j.get('pdbx_entity_nonpoly',{}).get('name','')
            ligands.append((eid, comp_id, name, desc, formula))
        except Exception:
            break
    if ligands:
        print(f'{pid}: {ligands}', flush=True)

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, re, sys, time

# Read antibody sequences
seqs={}
cur=None
for line in open('/app/antibody.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'):
        cur=line[1:].split()[0]
        seqs[cur]=''
    elif cur:
        seqs[cur]+=line

heavy=seqs['heavy']
light=seqs['light']

# Extract variable regions (before constant region)
# Heavy chain variable: up to WGQGTLVTVSS or similar
hv=re.match(r'^(.*?WGQG.{0,10}TVSS)', heavy)
hv_seq=hv.group(1) if hv else heavy[:120]
# Light chain variable: up to FGGGTKLEI or similar
lv=re.match(r'^(.*?FGGGTKLEI)', light)
lv_seq=lv.group(1) if lv else light[:110]

print('Heavy variable:', len(hv_seq), hv_seq[-30:], flush=True)
print('Light variable:', len(lv_seq), lv_seq[-30:], flush=True)

# Check old BLAST RID
print('\n=== Checking old BLAST RID ===', flush=True)
try:
    params={'CMD':'Get','FORMAT_OBJECT':'SearchInfo','RID':'4H69T3HW014'}
    req=urllib.request.Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    resp=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    status=re.search(r'Status=(\S+)', resp)
    print('Old RID status:', status.group(1) if status else 'unknown', flush=True)
    if status and status.group(1)=='READY':
        rparams={'CMD':'Get','FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2','ALIGNMENT_VIEW':'Pairwise','RID':'4H69T3HW014','RESULTS_FILE':'true'}
        rreq=urllib.request.Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(rparams), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        rresp=urllib.request.urlopen(rreq, timeout=60).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
        print('Old BLAST results:', rresp[:3000], flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print('Old RID check ERR', repr(e), flush=True)

# New BLAST against pdb (faster)
print('\n=== BLAST heavy variable against pdb ===', flush=True)
for name, seq in [('heavy_var', hv_seq), ('light_var', lv_seq)]:
    try:
        params={'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastp','DATABASE':'pdb','QUERY':seq,'FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2','HITLIST_SIZE':'10','EXPECT':'10'}
        data=urllib.parse.urlencode(params).encode()
        req=urllib.request.Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi', data=data, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        resp=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
        rid=re.search(r'RID = (\S+)', resp)
        if rid:
            rid=rid.group(1)
            print(f'{name} RID:', rid, flush=True)
            for i in range(15):
                time.sleep(5)
                gparams={'CMD':'Get','FORMAT_OBJECT':'SearchInfo','RID':rid}
                greq=urllib.request.Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(gparams), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
                gresp=urllib.request.urlopen(greq, timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
                status=re.search(r'Status=(\S+)', gresp)
                if status:
                    st=status.group(1)
                    print(f'  status: {st}', flush=True)
                    if st in ('READY','FAILED','UNKNOWN'):
                        if st=='READY':
                            rparams={'CMD':'Get','FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2','ALIGNMENT_VIEW':'Pairwise','RID':rid,'RESULTS_FILE':'true'}
                            rreq=urllib.request.Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(rparams), headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
                            rresp=urllib.request.urlopen(rreq, timeout=60).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
                            # Extract hit descriptions
                            hits=re.findall(r'Description: (.+?)\n', rresp)
                            print(f'  Hits: {hits[:10]}', flush=True)
                            print(f'  Results snippet: {rresp[:2000]}', flush=True)
                        break
                else:
                    print('  no status', flush=True)
                    break
        else:
            print(f'{name}: No RID', resp[:500], flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name} BLAST ERR', repr(e), flush=True)

import urllib.request, json, re, sys

# Extract DHFR from plasmid.gb
print('=== Extract DHFR from plasmid ===', flush=True)
genbank=open('/app/plasmid.gb').read()
# Get translation from CDS
cds_match=re.search(r'/translation="([^"]+)"', genbank.replace('\n',' ').replace('  ',' '))
if cds_match:
    dhfr_full=cds_match.group(1).replace(' ','')
    print('DHFR full protein:', len(dhfr_full), dhfr_full[:60], '...', dhfr_full[-30:], flush=True)
    # Remove N-terminal Met
    dhfr=dhfr_full[1:] if dhfr_full[0]=='M' else dhfr_full
    print('DHFR without Met:', len(dhfr), dhfr[:60], flush=True)

# Also extract DNA sequence from CDS location 88..567
origin_match=re.search(r'ORIGIN(.+)//', genbank, re.DOTALL)
if origin_match:
    raw=origin_match.group(1)
    dna=''.join(c for c in raw if c in 'ACGTacgt')
    print('Plasmid DNA length:', len(dna), flush=True)
    # DHFR CDS is at 88..567 (1-based)
    dhfr_dna=dna[87:567]
    print('DHFR DNA:', dhfr_dna, flush=True)
    print('DHFR DNA length:', len(dhfr_dna), flush=True)

# Get FPbase sequences for Clover and mCherry
print('\n=== FPbase sequences ===', flush=True)
url='https://www.fpbase.org/api/proteins/?format=json'
req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
prots=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
for p in prots:
    if p.get('slug') in ('clover','mcherry'):
        seq=p.get('seq','')
        states=p.get('states',[])
        print(f"\n{p['name']} ({p['slug']}):", flush=True)
        print(f'  pdb={p.get("pdb")}, states={[(s.get("ex_max"),s.get("em_max")) for s in states]}', flush=True)
        print(f'  seqlen={len(seq)}, seq={seq}', flush=True)

# Get PDB FASTA for 5WJ2 and 2H5Q
print('\n=== PDB FASTA for Clover/mCherry ===', flush=True)
for pid in ['5WJ2','2H5Q']:
    url=f'https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    # Parse sequence
    lines=data.strip().split('\n')
    hdr=lines[0]
    seq=''.join(lines[1:])
    print(f'{pid}: hdr={hdr[:80]}', flush=True)
    print(f'  seqlen={len(seq)}, seq={seq}', flush=True)

# Compare FPbase vs PDB
print('\n=== Compare FPbase vs PDB ===', flush=True)
fpbase={}
for p in prots:
    if p.get('slug') in ('clover','mcherry'):
        fpbase[p['slug']]=p.get('seq','')

# Get PDB sequences again
pdb_seqs={}
for pid in ['5WJ2','2H5Q']:
    url=f'https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    lines=data.strip().split('\n')
    pdb_seqs[pid]=''.join(lines[1:])

clover_fp=fpbase.get('clover','')
clover_pdb=pdb_seqs.get('5WJ2','')
mcherry_fp=fpbase.get('mcherry','')
mcherry_pdb=pdb_seqs.get('2H5Q','')

print('Clover FPbase len:', len(clover_fp), 'PDB len:', len(clover_pdb), flush=True)
print('mCherry FPbase len:', len(mcherry_fp), 'PDB len:', len(mcherry_pdb), flush=True)

# Find where FPbase sequence matches within PDB sequence
if clover_fp and clover_pdb:
    for i in range(len(clover_pdb)-len(clover_fp)+1):
        mismatches=sum(1 for a,b in zip(clover_pdb[i:i+len(clover_fp)], clover_fp) if a!=b)
        if mismatches<=5:
            print(f'Clover: FPbase matches PDB at offset {i}, mismatches={mismatches}', flush=True)
            diff=[(j, clover_pdb[i+j], clover_fp[j]) for j in range(min(len(clover_fp),len(clover_pdb)-i)) if clover_pdb[i+j]!=clover_fp[j]]
            print(f'  Differences: {diff}', flush=True)
            break

if mcherry_fp and mcherry_pdb:
    mismatches=sum(1 for a,b in zip(mcherry_pdb, mcherry_fp) if a!=b)
    diff=[(i, mcherry_pdb[i], mcherry_fp[i]) for i in range(min(len(mcherry_fp),len(mcherry_pdb))) if mcherry_pdb[i]!=mcherry_fp[i]]
    print(f'mCherry: mismatches with PDB={mismatches}, diff={diff}', flush=True)
